Collaborative research is an essential part of my activity in mathematical and theoretical physics. This page documents **selected scientific collaborations**; it is not intended as an exhaustive list of co-authors.

## Selected collaborators

::: entry-list
- **Inés Cavero-Peláez** — quantum vacuum interactions and Casimir physics.
- **Gonzalo Sancho-Garrido** — spectral and quantum-field-theoretic problems.
- **Michael Bordag** — quantum vacuum energy and boundary effects.
- **Klaus Kirsten** — spectral geometry, heat kernels and zeta functions.
- **Juan Mateos Guilarte** — quantum field theory and soliton physics.
- **Manuel Asorey** — quantum field theory and boundary conditions.
- **Jesús Clemente-Gallardo** — mathematical physics and research collaboration.
:::

The names above identify selected collaborations reflected in joint scientific activity. Specific institutions, dates and projects will be linked here only after verification against public records and the current CV.

## Joint publications

Selected joint papers and their DOI or arXiv references appear in [Publications](publications.qmd). Individual collaborations can be documented through **verifiable outcomes**, rather than simply lists of names.

## Visits, networks and projects

Scientific visits, international research networks and funded-project roles will be added with their dates, funding references and supporting institutional links once verified. Unpublished project plans and confidential work are not displayed.
